text: No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected on this 311.2-hectare rural property after 2020 (through 2025). The analysis used high-resolution satellite data (30m pixels) from Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020, with full coverage of the asset. While small-scale changes (under 0.5 ha) or edge losses might have been missed, no significant deforestation events were identified during the 2021–2025 period. The property retained over 90% forest cover as of 2020.
